title: Kate put her baby shark in the washing machine
description: Laundry day takes a dark turn, and later Jeff dreams up a Halloween scheme for treats.
hook_note: A sleepy baby shark about to get accidentally washed is pure adorable dread.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: This is Jeff the Land Shark, curled up asleep in a laundry basket, sweet as can be.

segments.text: This is Jeff the Land Shark, curled up asleep in a laundry basket, sweet as can be.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: His owner Kate Bishop, humming away, starts loading up the wash without looking.

segments.text: His owner Kate Bishop, humming away, starts loading up the wash without looking.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Which is when we find the little guy already inside the machine, absolutely losing it.

segments.text: Which is when we find the little guy already inside the machine, absolutely losing it.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And before she notices, Kate hits the button.

segments.text: And before she notices, Kate hits the button.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: She walks back in to find Jeff happily swimming laps in a full-blown whirlpool.

segments.text: She walks back in to find Jeff happily swimming laps in a full-blown whirlpool.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: The machine overflows, Kate panics, and the GOAT just keeps singing through the flood.

segments.text: The machine overflows, Kate panics, and the GOAT just keeps singing through the flood.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Later, everyone's out surfing, and the little guy knows exactly what one shark fin does to a beach.

segments.text: Later, everyone's out surfing, and the little guy knows exactly what one shark fin does to a beach.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: So he finds a costume shop, and walks out with the perfect disguise.

segments.text: So he finds a costume shop, and walks out with the perfect disguise.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: A dolphin. He spends the whole day surfing as the world's happiest fake dolphin.

segments.text: A dolphin. He spends the whole day surfing as the world's happiest fake dolphin.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And not one person suspects a thing.
